cohort: 130 women with singleton pregnancies, antenatally suspected and pathologically confirmed morbidly adherent placenta who underwent cesarean hysterectomy between January 1, 2011, and February 30, 2017
finding: Women with morbidly adherent placenta requiring urgent delivery experience worse outcomes compared to those with planned delivery.
mod_finding: Women with morbidly adherent placenta requiring urgent delivery (as opposed to planned delivery) have worse outcomes.
